verdict.rationale: The CLI supports listing skill contents before installing (`--list` flag enumerates names/descriptions without installing, confirmed in a runtime probe) and installed skills are written as plain files/symlinks that can be opened and read afterward. However, there is no evidence of a diff/preview command showing full file contents or scripts pre-install, no documented security scanning, and a community comment explicitly notes distrust of unreviewed embedded instructions, showing the review workflow is manual rather than tool-assisted. missing for 10: a pre-install full-content/script preview (not just name+description), documented per-file diff or audit tooling, and independent verification that all files (not just prompts) are readable post-install.
